sentences.text: The prosecution story in short is that in the year 2023 co-accused Roop Singh Parihar was appointed in land acquisition office for assistance in the land acquisition matters.

On 18.05.2024, it was informed by Clerk Siya Ram posted in land acquisition office and presently posted Clerk Vijay Sharma that in compliance of the order dated 08.02.2023 of the Collector an amount of Rs.
6,55,511/- was to be paid to four persons but instead an amount of Rs.26, 55, 521/- was paid to eight persons.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that these are second bail applications after dismissal of first bail applications of applicants namely Seema, Sanjeev, Kamal Singh vide orders dated 28.08.2024 passed in M.Cr.C.Nos.30955/2024, 31865/2024 and 30938/2024 respectively.
Now charge-sheet has been filed on 21.09.2024 and period of custody of applicants also enhanced

,
therefore, in this changed circumstances these second applications have been filed.

It is further submitted that the applicant Seema is a lady and access amount of around Rs.21,00,000/- of compensation has been deposited in the account of Smt. Seema, so the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:218 3 MCRC-43431-2024 matter is different in relation to present applicant Seema.
There is no evidence as regards forgery against her.
It is a matter of deposition of access compensation.
As against other applicants also no offence of forgery is made out having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case.
They are ready and willing to abide by any conditions which may be imposed by the Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.

In the changed circumstances,
learned counsel pray for grant of bail to the applicants.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application on the ground that the fraud and forgery have been committed on large scale.
The amount involved in this case is more than rupees five crores.
It is also submitted that there is ample evidence against the applicants.

Earlier bail applications were dismissed on merits and there is no substantial changed in circumstances for filing these subsequent bail applications, therefore, he prays to reject the bail application of the applicants.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Earlier first bail applications of the present applicants have been dismissed with detailed order passed.

Entire facts and circumstances were considered in that order and no substantial change has been occurred after dismissal of first bail application which may give rise to a situation for filing second/subsequent bail applications.
The offence has been committed in relation to the huge amount of Government Exchequer of rupee more than five crores.
The present applicants are beneficiaries of such amount in part.

In the considered opinion of this Court having regard to the attending facts and circumstances of the case but without commencing on the merits, at this NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:218 4 MCRC-43431-2024 stage, no case for grant of regular bail is made out in this second/subsequent bail applications.
Accordingly, the applications are dismissed.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE Monika Kamal Singh Parihar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182272500/
